name: claude-mem
description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
one_liner: Gives an AI coding assistant a memory, so it stops forgetting your project every time you start a new chat.
buyer: A solo developer or small dev team paying for Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools who is tired of re-explaining their project's architecture and decisions every single session.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer runs it per client so each morning's session resumes exactly where yesterday's left off, cutting unbillable 'get the AI back up to speed' time.
A dev agency standardizes it across the team so a client's architecture and decisions survive staff turnover and tool resets.
A cohort-based coding bootcamp bundles it so each student's AI pair-programmer remembers earlier lessons across a multi-week curriculum.

money_ideas.idea: A hosted, managed version of the memory-compression pipeline so non-technical teams don't have to run the infrastructure themselves.
Paid 'memory packs' — pre-seeded project context for popular frameworks so a new project starts with best-practice context already injected.

steal_this: Package the memory-compression engine as a lightweight companion tool for a single popular IDE AI plugin and sell it to the huge audience already annoyed by context loss.
